BBCSelect.us.description: S4 E21 The Underwater Menace: Episode 3 The Doctor hatches a dangerous plan to kidnap Professor Zaroff.

E4+1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E5 — Jazmin and Sonny Sonny is a party fanatic. His bride Jasmine is unsure about his plans for a zoo-themed Ibizan beach party with body paint.

E4+1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E6 — Leanne and Jai The sky's the limit for adrenaline junkie Jai as he plans on having a wedding in the sky, neglecting the fact that his bride-to-be Leanne is terrified of heights.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E6 — Revisited No. 1 Gordon Ramsay revisits Café Hon in Hampden, Maryland, Chiarella's in Philadelphia, and Leone's in Montclair, New Jersey, to see whether the restaurant owners have taken his advice on board.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E7 — Olde Hitching Post Gordon heads to the historic Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, where he meets an owner so stubborn and set in his ways that he doesn't realise he's the reason his restaurant is losing money. Owner Tom bought the business for his daughter Andrea, but six years later he is still refusing to let her run it. Gordon must fight a controlling boss who doesn't react well to his criticism.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E8 — Levanti's Italian Restaurant In Beaver, Pennsylvania, where he finds a brother-and-sister team who are unable to work together positively at an Italian restaurant called Levanti's. Their relationship is so fractured that they are failing to save their father's business from being overwhelmed by competition from other local eateries. The situation has become desperate, and dad Tony is now in danger of losing his life savings.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E9 — Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room Gordon visits family-owned restaurant Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room in Monrovia, California. Within minutes of his arrival, Gordon is caught in the crossfire of an argument between owner Sam, his wife and their children, all of whom are feeling the pressure of working in the restaurant seven days a week.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E10 — Nino's Italian Restaurant Gordon heads to Long Beach, California, to save Nino's, an Italian family restaurant that was opened in 1958 and is now under the misguided leadership of the eldest son, Nino. Younger brother Michael and sister Carina point the finger of blame for the restaurant's failings directly at Nino, and their 78-year-old mother Inge is desperate for Nino to turn the business around.

E4+1.uk.title: Turner & Hooch
E4+1.uk.description: Detective Scott Turner is an uptight, by-the-book police officer who hopes to leave his sleepy California town and work in the big city. When his friend Amos Reed, the proprietor of a junkyard, is killed, Turner reluctantly inherits the man's dog. Realising that the canine may be able to help him solve the murder case, Turner attempts to adjust to life with the big dog, resulting in much household destruction and unwelcome chaos.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E13 — Selma's Choice After Homer gets sick from a giant sandwich he's been eating for months, Aunt Selma steps in to take the kids to a new alcohol-based theme park, with near-disastrous consequences.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E14 — Brother From the Same Planet When Homer is late picking up Bart from a school football game, Bart protests by hooking himself up with Tom, a surrogate dad from an agency. Stung by being jilted by his own son, Homer gets into a monster brawl with Tom that even makes the news.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E15 — I Love Lisa Valentine's Day comes to Springfield and Lisa takes pity on Ralph and gives him a card, but when Ralph falls in love with Lisa their friendship turns bad, causing a bitter feud to break out between the two families.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E16 — Duffless After Homer fails a breathalyser test-driving home from a visit to the Duff brewery, he is forced to quit drinking for a month. Meanwhile, Lisa buys a hamster for her school science project, in order to prove that Bart is dumber than a rodent.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E17 — Last Exit to Springfield Homer takes on Mr Burns in a labour struggle that rapidly spirals out of control. When Homer leads the workers out on strike, Mr Burns retaliates by hiring robots to replace them and shutting off power to the city.

E4+1.uk.title: The Great British Bake Off
E4+1.uk.description: The Great Christmas Bake Off 2021 The stars of `It's A Sin' join Paul Hollywood, Prue Leith, Matt Lucas and Noel Fielding in the white tent to celebrate Christmas. Olly Alexander, Nathaniel Curtis, Lydia West and Shaun Dooley compete for the coveted Christmas Star Baker title.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey - Bangladesh
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rick ends his culinary tour in Bangladesh, the country that spawned thousands of Indian restaurants in Britain years ago. Not surprisingly, curry is at the top of his list.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Into the Kitchen - Ambition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Born into a country life in Devon England, Kirk started working in kitchens at a young age. Through sheer hard work, stubbornness, and drive he worked his way up through the culinary world.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gary Barlow's Wine Tour: South Africa - Gary Barlow With Special Guest Eliot Kennedy And Michaela Strachen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Gary and best friend Eliot continue their wine education in South Africa, heading to Babylonstoren Wine Estate where they are set to work by the chief winemaker but also the resident gardener!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World - Eating On The Hood Of Your Car In La
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Buckle up! When you're in LA, your car's your sanctuary. Treat it with the respect it deserves and dig in to life-changing hot chicken, fresh bread drops and museum-worthy bento boxes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Thai Street Food: Best Kept Secrets - Foodcourts: From 12 Til 1
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: In Thai office life, lunchtime is a serious business. We step into food court vendors in the busy centre of Bangkok, juxtaposed with the spiritual food courts found in ancient vegetarian communities.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet Christmas - Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield Xmas 2019
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: It's the most wonderful time of the year, the Everyday Gourmet Christmas Special is here! This year Justine Schofield and her special guests will be sharing some of their favourite festive recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams - Island Dreams Satay Skewers
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: For the perfect skewers, Alimah was taught to imagine she was sewing a running stitch when threading the skewer through the meat. She shares an Island Dreams satay favourite.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Remarkable Places To Eat - Rome
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Giorgio Locatelli takes Fred to Rome in search of the city's most exciting eats. Sublime pasta, fluffy gnocchi and the world's best pizza - all delicious but affordable.

Paul begins to question whether Coffey is truly guilty of murdering the two girls.

Subsequent tensions within the crew and numerous technical problems threaten both the astronauts' survival and their safe return to Earth.

Meanwhile, Iosef's father (Michael Nyqvist) -- John's former colleague -- puts a huge bounty on John's head. (movie) - 2014

badgirlsclub.us.description: Camilla fights to stay to the end; the remaining Bad Girls get sentimental.

badgirlsclub.us.description: Meghan's lingerie-themed birthday party forces the girls to put their differences aside.

badgirlsclub.us.description: Alicia and Valentina make amends; house gossip causes Nancy's temper to skyrocket.

badgirlsclub.us.title: Bad Girls Club: Atlanta - Rocky Like a Hurricane

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

cinemax.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart.

cinemax.us.title: The Greatest Showman
cinemax.us.description: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money.

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

cinemax.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemax.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region.

cinemax.us.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
cinemax.us.description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (movie) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Predator
cinemax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxaction.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger).

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxaction.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxaction.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman).

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxaction.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Joker
cinemaxaction.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
cinemaxaction.us.description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemaxaction.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (movie) - 2020

cinemaxaction.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxaction.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.description: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms.

cinemaxclassics.us.description: Clover must leave her family behind to compete in an algorithm-based singing competition; pressure from the judges leads Clover to doubt herself, but her family's words give her the strength to perform.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives - The Prince and the Pauper
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Trapped in a bizarre, bureaucratic afterlife, a famous Mohawk ghost is drawn into an encounter with an identical and partially-deceased descendant.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Talk Black
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A timid engineer develops a wild and expressive split personality that helps her stand up to male co-workers.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Fantastic Planet
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other?

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Head Office
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Rodan
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Hobbit
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Dim Sum Funeral
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the wake of her death, the embittered children of Chinese-American matriarch Mrs. Xiao (Lisa Lu) begrudgingly return to their childhood home for a bristly -- and brief, they hope -- reunion. But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Head Office
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (movie) - 1986

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Last Emperor
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This sweeping account of the life of Pu Yi (John Lone), the last emperor of China, follows the leader's tumultuous reign. After being captured by the Red Army as a war criminal in 1950, Pu Yi recalls his childhood from prison. He remembers his lavish youth in the Forbidden City, where he was afforded every luxury but unfortunately sheltered from the outside world and complex political situation surrounding him. As revolution sweeps through China, the world Pu Yi knew is dramatically upended. (movie) - 1987

cinemaxhits.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxhits.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet.

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Way, Way Back
cinemaxhits.us.description: Duncan (Liam James) is an awkward teen who must spend the summer at a beach house with his mother (Toni Collette), her boyfriend, Trent (Steve Carell), and Trent's obnoxious daughter. Trent can't resist badgering Duncan, so the youth steals away to a water park and gets a job that will help him stay off Trent's radar. As Duncan tends to the slides and pools of the aging park, he finds a father figure in wisecracking park manager Owen (Sam Rockwell) at a time when he desperately needs one.

cinemaxhits.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
cinemaxhits.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Smoking Tigers
cinemaxhits.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
cinemaxhits.us.description: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Shazam!
cinemaxhits.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
cinemaxhits.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Robin Hood
cinemaxhits.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Rampage
cinemaxhits.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Tomb Raider
cinemaxhits.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemaxhits.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxwest.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemaxwest.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxwest.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemaxwest.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart.

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Greatest Showman
cinemaxwest.us.description: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemaxwest.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxwest.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxwest.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxwest.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (movie) - 2007

cinemaxwest.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemaxwest.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (movie) - 2013

cinesony.us.title: Southland Tales
cinesony.us.description: En un futuro distópico, los destinos de cuatro personas se entrelazan con los de toda la humanidad cuando una nueva tecnología amenaza con destruir el mundo.

cinesony.us.title: Planet Action
cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood.

cinesony.us.title: Dragon Wars
cinesony.us.description: Ethan Kendrick (Jason Behr) descubre que unas criaturas antiguas llamadas Imoogi han regresado a la Tierra, y la única forma de detenerlas es con la ayuda de Sarah (Amanda Brooks). Basada en una leyenda coreana.

cinesony.us.title: Absolute Deception
cinesony.us.description: Una periodista hace equipo con un agente federal para descubrir la verdad detrás de la muerte de su esposo.

cinesony.us.title: Blue Streak
cinesony.us.description: Un ladrón en libertad condicional se hace pasar por policía para recuperar un diamante que escondió en una estación policíaca.

cinesony.us.title: Death at a Funeral
cinesony.us.description: Prepararse para un funeral no es nada agradable. Aarón tiene el peor día de su vida cuando trata de dar a su difunto padre un merecido funeral, pero amigos y familiares provocan un caos.

cinesony.us.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
cinesony.us.description: Un detective de poca monta descubre algo más que un simple secuestro en su búsqueda de la mascota desaparecida de los Miami Dolphins.

cinesony.us.title: Big Daddy
cinesony.us.description: Un irresponsable neoyorquino trata de darle estabilidad a su vida al adoptar a un niño rebelde de cinco años.

cinesony.us.title: The Social Network
cinesony.us.description: Mark Zuckerberg, un estudiante de Harvard, crea la red social que terminará convirtiéndose en Facebook, pero recibe acusaciones del cofundador y de dos hermanos que sostienen que la idea fue suya.

cinesony.us.title: Jerry Maguire
cinesony.us.description: Jerry Maguire, agente deportivo, pierde su empleo y debe reinventar su carrera profesional con solo dos aliados: un futbolista de segunda categoría y una secretaria, madre soltera.

cinevault.us.title: Crazy in Alabama
cinevault.us.description: In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement.

cinevault.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
cinevault.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

cinevault.us.title: The Mask of Zorro
cinevault.us.description: After being imprisoned for 20 years, Zorro -- Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) -- receives word that his old enemy, Don Rafael Montero (Stuart Wilson), has returned. Don Diego escapes and returns to his old headquarters, where he trains aimless drunk Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas) to be his successor. Meanwhile, Montero -- who has secretly raised Diego's daughter, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), as his own -- hatches a plot to rob California of its gold.

cinevault.us.title: The Legend of Zorro
cinevault.us.description: A secret society, the Knights of Aragon, seeks to keep the United States from achieving manifest destiny -- and only the legendary Zorro (Antonio Banderas) can stop them. Unfortunately, Zorro, also known as Don Alejandro de la Vega, has problems of his own: His wife, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is divorcing him for spending too much time pursuing heroics and not enough being a father to their young son. But it isn't long before the whole family gets caught up in stopping the Knights.

cinevault.us.title: Last Action Hero
cinevault.us.description: Following the death of his father, young Danny Madigan (Austin O'Brien) takes comfort in watching action movies featuring the indestructible Los Angeles cop Jack Slater (Arnold Schwarzenegger). After being given a magic ticket by theater manager Nick (Robert Prosky), Danny is sucked into the screen and bonds with Slater. When evil fictional villain Benedict (Charles Dance) gets his hands on the ticket and enters the real world, Danny and Jack must follow and stop him.

cinevault.us.title: The Green Hornet
cinevault.us.description: Britt Reid (Seth Rogen), the heir to the largest newspaper fortune in Los Angeles, is a spoiled playboy who has been, thus far, happy to lead an aimless life. After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz).

circlecountry.us.title: There Was a Crooked Man
circlecountry.us.description: After a botched heist, Wild West bandit Paris Pitman Jr. (Kirk Douglas) hides his newly stolen money where no one will find it, then loses his entire gang in a blaze of bullets before being captured by the law and given a lengthy sentence in a desert jail. Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak.

circlecountry.us.title: Leanne Morgan: So Yummy
circlecountry.us.description: Leanne Morgan gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs, and cheerleading camp.

circlecountry.us.description: Kate is missing as a big convention is meeting to decide where to hold their convention, she is stuck in a cave.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - Kate Flat on Her Back
circlecountry.us.description: With Kate injured, Uncle Joe and the daughters must corner the convention.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Genghis Keane Story
circlecountry.us.description: Kate is surprised at her old school teacher's new personality.

circlecountry.us.title: Circle Shorts

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Genghis Keane Story

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - San Francisco
circlecountry.us.description: Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - Bitter Water
circlecountry.us.description: When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - Feet of Clay
circlecountry.us.description: The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - Dark Star
circlecountry.us.description: Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

circlecountry.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Jed Becomes a Banker
circlecountry.us.description: Jed is promoted to the position of bank vice president in order for him to participate in an interbank skeet shoot.

circlecountry.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - The Family Tree
circlecountry.us.description: An authority on American history finds evidence that Jed's ancestors preceded the Mayflower to America.

circlecountry.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Jed Cuts the Family Tree
circlecountry.us.description: Cousin Pearl gets a glamour treatment and tries to groom the Clampetts for high society.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - Please Buy My Violets
circlecountry.us.description: Uncle Joe decides to go into the cologne business.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Ringer
circlecountry.us.description: Betty Jo becomes the first female contestant in the horseshoe tournament.

circlecountry.us.title: The Andy Griffith Show - A Wife for Andy
circlecountry.us.description: Barney thinks it's time Andy got married, but Andy has a plan of his own.

circlecountry.us.title: The Andy Griffith Show - Dogs, Dogs, Dogs
circlecountry.us.description: A pack of hunting dogs overruns the Mayberry courthouse just as Andy is trying to impress a state official.

circlecountry.us.title: The Hellbenders
circlecountry.us.description: The Civil War is over, and the South has fallen, but Col. Jonas (Joseph Cotten) has a plan to revive the Confederacy. He raids a Union Army detail and walks away with valuable treasure that he intends to put to use raising another rebel army. Jonas needs to keep the treasure safe during shipment, so he places it in a coffin and forces saloon girl Claire (Norma Bengell) to play widow. Claire is unwilling to do her part, however, and puts herself in danger by opposing the dangerous Jonas.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 8
classica.us.description: Mahlers 8. Symphonie, auch bekannt als die Symphonie der Tausend, ist ein monumentales Chor-Epos aus dem Jahr 1906, das ein riesiges Ensemble aus Solisten, Chören und einem gewaltigen Orchester erfordert.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartette Nr. 2, 14 und 16
classica.us.description: Das Quatuor Ébène präsentiert in der Philharmonie de Paris Meisterwerke aus Beethovens Streichquartettrepertoire. Zum Jubiläum des Komponisten spielt das renommierte französische Ensemble die Streichquartette Nr. 2, 14 und 16.

classica.us.title: Wer hat das Boléro von Maurice Ravel gestohlen?
classica.us.description: In der Dokumentation wird der Rechtsstreit um das Musikstück Boléro untersucht. Das Stück wird von Maurice Ravel im Jahr 1928 komponiert und dieser gibt die Rechte an seinen Bruder Edouard. Dieser stirbt 1960 und löst den Rechtsstreit aus.

classica.us.title: Martha Argerich - Eine Geburtstagsfeier - III
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Kammermusikrepertoire in einem wunderbaren Konzert. Die "Grande Dame des Klaviers" wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 8. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in F-Dur Op. 93, welche in den Jahren 1812 und 1813 geschrieben wurde und im Jahr 1814 ihre Erstaufführung feierte.

classica.us.title: Hommage an Hans van Manen
classica.us.description: Der Sender bietet Ihnen diese Hommage an Hans van Manen mit dem niederländischen Nationalballett.

classica.us.title: Klavierduette - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff u. a
classica.us.description: In diesem prächtigen Konzert vereinen sich zwei außergewöhnliche russische Pianisten, Nikolay Lugansky und Vadim Rudenko. Diese Aufführung wurde am 25. November 2021 in der Tschaikowski-Konzerthalle in Moskau, Russland, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
classica.us.description: Das Dänische nationale Symphonieorchester spielt beliebte Kompositionen von legendären Videospielen. Mit dabei sind Melodien aus "The Legend of Zelda", "League of Legends", "Halo", "World of Warcraft" und vielen weiteren Videospielklassikern.

classica.us.title: Schumann - 3. Klaviersonate, Op. 14
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Riccardo Schwartz spielt die dritte Klaviersonate, Op. 14 von Robert Schumann.

classica.us.title: Schubert - Rosamunde Ouvertüre (D. 644)
classica.us.description: Andreas Spering dirigiert die Philharmonie Zuidnederland in einer Aufführung in Eindhoven 2015.

Knowing that he won't survive more than a few minutes in prison on his own, James turns to Darnell, a Black businessman who's never even had a parking ticket, for help. As Darnell puts James through the wringer, both learn that they were wrong about many things, including each other.

comedycentral.us.title: Happy Gilmore
comedycentral.us.description: All Happy Gilmore (Adam Sandler) has ever wanted is to be a professional hockey player. But he soon discovers he may actually have a talent for playing an entirely different sport: golf. When his grandmother (Frances Bay) learns she is about to lose her home, Happy joins a golf tournament to try and win enough money to buy it for her. With his powerful driving skills and foulmouthed attitude, Happy becomes an unlikely golf hero -- much to the chagrin of the well-mannered golf professionals.

comedycentral.us.title: We're the Millers

Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.

comedycentral.us.title: The Hangover
comedycentral.us.description: Two days before his wedding, Doug (Justin Bartha) and three friends (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) drive to Las Vegas for a wild and memorable stag party. In fact, when the three groomsmen wake up the next morning, they can't remember a thing; nor can they find Doug. With little time to spare, the three hazy pals try to re-trace their steps and find Doug so they can get him back to Los Angeles in time to walk down the aisle.

comedycentral.us.title: The Hangover Part III
comedycentral.us.description: It's been two years since the gang known as the Wolfpack narrowly escaped disaster in Bangkok. Now, Phil (Bradley Cooper), Stu (Ed Helms) and Doug (Justin Bartha) have happy lives at home -- but Alan (Zach Galifianakis) doesn't. Still lacking contentment and a sense of purpose, Alan has gone off his meds and surrendered to his natural impulses. It's up to the other members of the Wolfpack to get him through his personal crisis by embarking on a road trip to the place it all began: Las Vegas.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E06 Jason drives the Aston Martin V8 Vantage Roadster, Jonny tests the car James Bond drove in Casino Royale.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E08 Tom Ford and Jonny Smith enter a demolition derby in two unlikely vehicles, Reliant Robins; Tiff Needell tests the latest Porsche 911, the GT3RS; Vicki Butler-Henderson drives the new Vauxhall VXR8.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson tests the latest BMW X5 4.8i; it's an impressive machine, costing £50,000, it does 150mph; Jason Plato tests the ultimate track car, the brand-new Lotus 2 Eleven.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E02 Tom gets an advance look at Formula 1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone's rare and unusual collection of cars; Tiff and Jason take the BMW M3 and the Mercedes C63 AMG to a circuit to determine which is most deserving of its £50,000 price tag.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E03 Vicki finds out which is quickest, an old Vauxhall against a new one; Jonny Smith and Tom Ford contest one of motor sport's oldest and most grueling events, the Exeter Trial; Tiff Needell goes to France to drive the new Audi A3 Cabriolet.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E04 Vicki tests the Mercedes Vito X or the VW Transporter Sportline on the track to find out which is quickest; Jonny embarks on the 600-mile transcontinental trip in the BMW 635d; Tom drives the ultimate 4x4, the 12-ton, 10-foot tall Unimog.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E05 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is the fastest, the Renault Twingo GT or the Fiat Panda 100HP; Tiff Needell and Jason Plato go head-to-head; this time it's small coupes as the Porsche Cayman comes up against the new BMW 135i Coupe.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them.

filmriseaction.us.title: Direct Contact
filmriseaction.us.description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman.

filmriseaction.us.title: Abduction
filmriseaction.us.description: A man steps out of a fountain in a park in Ho Chi Minh City with no memory of who he is. He wanders the city trying to piece together his past while being pursued by mysterious figures.

filmriseaction.us.title: Cover-Up
filmriseaction.us.description: An American journalist (Dolph Lundgren) gets too close to the truth about alleged terrorist attacks in Tel Aviv.

filmriseaction.us.title: Castle Falls
filmriseaction.us.description: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

filmriseaction.us.title: Arlington Road
filmriseaction.us.description: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

filmriseaction.us.title: JCVD
filmriseaction.us.description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night

Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

When Derek dashes the dreams of a young fan, he is quickly sentenced to serve time as a real tooth fairy, complete with wings and magic wand. Though he can't "handle the tooth" at first, Derek's new job helps him to slowly rediscover the dreams that he gave up long ago.

freeform.us.title: Maleficent: Mistress of Evil
freeform.us.description: Maleficent travels to a grand old castle to celebrate young Aurora's upcoming wedding to Prince Phillip. While there, she meets Aurora's future mother-in-law -- a conniving queen who hatches a devious plot to destroy the land's fairies. Hoping to stop her, Maleficent joins forces with a seasoned warrior and a group of outcasts to battle the queen and her powerful army.

freeform.us.title: Disney's A Christmas Carol
freeform.us.description: Though London awaits the joyful arrival of Christmas, miserly Ebenezer Scrooge (Jim Carrey) thinks it's all humbug, berating his faithful clerk and cheerful nephew for their view. Later, Scrooge encounters the ghost of his late business partner, who warns that three spirits will visit him this night. The ghosts take Scrooge on a journey through his past, present and future in the hope of transforming his bitterness.

freeform.us.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas

Reluctantly joined by his hapless dog, Max, the Grinch comes down from his mountaintop home and sneaks into town to swipe everything holiday-related from the Whos. However, the bitter grump finds a hitch in his plans when he encounters the endearing Cindy Lou Who (Taylor Momsen).

freeform.us.title: Monsters, Inc.

His scare assistant, best friend and roommate is Mike Wazowski (Billy Crystal), a green, opinionated, feisty little one-eyed monster. Visiting from the human world is Boo (Mary Gibbs), a tiny girl who goes where no human has ever gone before.

freeform.us.title: Monsters University
freeform.us.description: Ever since he was a kid monster, Mike Wazowski (Billy Crystal) has dreamed of becoming a Scarer. To make his dream a reality, he enrolls at Monsters University. With Pepper Potts (Gwyneth Paltrow) and "Rhodey" Rhodes (Don Cheadle) by his side, Tony must forge new alliances and confront a powerful new enemy. (movie) - 2010

fx.us.title: Iron Man 3
fx.us.description: Plagued with worry and insomnia since saving New York from destruction, Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.), now, is more dependent on the suits that give him his Iron Man persona -- so much so that every aspect of his life is affected, including his relationship with Pepper (Gwyneth Paltrow). Tattered and forlorn, Eve shows up in the dressing room of Broadway mega-star Margo Channing, telling a melancholy life story to Margo and her friends. Margo takes Eve under her wing, and it appears that Eve is a conniver that uses Margo.

fxm.us.title: Blood and Sand
fxm.us.description: Brash young Spanish peasant Juan Gallardo (Tyrone Power) aspires to follow his dead father's footsteps into the bullring, despite his mother's fears. Bidding his childhood sweetheart Carmen (Linda Darnell) farewell, Juan and his friends travel to Madrid to learn the bullfighting craft. Years later, when Juan's fame as a matador soars, he returns to Seville to marry Carmen. Soon, Juan's head is turned by the elegant temptress Doña Sol De Muira (Rita Hayworth), and his career takes a turn.

fxm.us.title: The Black Swan
fxm.us.description: With the pardon of notorious pirate Henry Morgan by the English King, Caribbean pirates are offered amnesty if they give up their lawless ways. As governor of Jamaica, Morgan picks Captain Jamie Waring to round up the renegade captain Billy Leech. Beautiful Margaret Denby complicates matters for Waring, as her scorn for him is matched only by his love for her.

fxm.us.title: The Black Rose
fxm.us.description: Following the 13th-century death of his nobleman father, Walter of Gurnie (Tyrone Power) and his confidant, Tristram (Jack Hawkins), join a caravan led by the North African Bayan (Orson Welles) en route to China. Along the way, the beautiful Maryam (Cecile Aubry), known as the Black Rose, begs Walter to take her to England with him. When the warlord Bayan reveals his intention to invade and subjugate China's advanced society, the trio attempt their escape back to England.

fxm.us.title: The Lion
fxm.us.description: Living an idyllic existence on a Kenyan wildlife preserve, Tina (Pamela Franklin) is remarkably at home with the resident animals. In fact, she is so comfortable with the various creatures that her best friend is an adult lion. While Tina isn't too worried by this relationship, her mother, Christine (Capucine), becomes extremely concerned, and requests that her ex-husband -- Tina's father, Robert (William Holden) -- come for a visit to help straighten the girl out.

fxm.us.title: The Book of Life
fxm.us.description: In the Mexican town of San Angel, Manolo (Diego Luna), Maria (Zoë Saldana) and Joaquin (Channing Tatum) have been friends ever since childhood. Although their lives have taken different paths -- Maria was sent to Europe, Joaquin joined the military, and Manolo studied to become a bullfighter -- one thing remains the same: Manolo and Joaquin both want to marry Maria. Little does the trio know that battling husband-and-wife deities have made a high-stakes wager on the love triangle's outcome.

fxm.us.title: The Aftermath

As they set off for their new home, Rachael is stunned to discover that Lewis has made an unexpected decision: They will be sharing the grand house with its previous owners, a German widower and his troubled daughter. In this charged atmosphere, enmity and grief give way to passion and betrayal.

grit.us.description: Larry Delong loses his sister and her son when they're gunned down by the notorious Dan Marady and his band of outlaws during a holdup. Delong takes a job as a stagecoach guard, hoping to run into the bandits and take revenge. Run into them, he does, but numbers are on Marady's side, and they shoot up and rob Delong's coach. Delong barely escapes with his life. When he tries to alert the authorities, they implicate him in the crime, and he becomes a fugitive.

grit.us.title: Joe Kidd
grit.us.description: In New Mexico, one-time bounty hunter Joe Kidd owns a ranch where a nearby group of Mexican revolutionaries, led by Luis Chama, fights for their rightful land after the U.S. government denies their claims. In response, a greedy landowner gathers a posse to capture Chama and solicits Kidd's assistance. Kidd, who has no interest in the matter, changes his mind when he discovers Chama has stolen a horse and roughed up a worker from his ranch.

grit.us.title: High Plains Drifter
grit.us.description: In this Western, a drifter with no name wanders into a small town, where his gun-slinging abilities are in high demand. When the drifter rides into Lago, he is met with incredulity and disapproval by the townspeople. But once he shows his skills with a pistol, the locals realize he may be able to help them fend off a band of criminals who have been terrorizing the town. He agrees to help the townspeople, but does so with his own secret agenda.

grit.us.title: Money, Women and Guns
grit.us.description: After finding gold, an elderly miner is attacked by three thugs. He manages to kill two of the crooks before the third one murders him and flees. The local law enforcement is confounded by the case, so they enlist the sharpest sleuth in the West -- "Silver" Ward Hogan (Jock Mahoney) -- to find the surviving culprit and decipher the victim's cryptic will. With the help of fiery rancher Mary Kingman (Kim Hunter), Ward sets out to find the fugitive and the heirs to the old man's treasure.

history.us.title: Mountain Men - Wild North: To the Bone

history.us.title: Mountain Men - Wild North: Racing the Thaw
history.us.description: As winter gives way to spring, the Wild North becomes increasingly unpredictable; melting snow, treacherous terrain and a sudden whiteout force the mountain men to race the changing conditions before their windows of opportunity disappear.

history.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors - Chesapeake Bay Stingray Controversy ᴺᵉʷ
history.us.description: Kyle and Jeff head to the nation's capital and the Chesapeake Bay to investigate the controversy surrounding cownose rays and their disputed impact on the crabbing industry. A crab distributor, a bowfishing guide who targets the rays, an animal rights activist, fishermen, and a restaurant owner share competing perspectives as the team explores how these migratory animals should be managed.

history.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors - Fishing in Hemingway's Footsteps ᴺᵉʷ
history.us.description: Kyle and Jeff trace Ernest Hemingway's fishing legacy, hearing childhood fishing stories from his great-nephew in Michigan. They learn how Hemingway inspired Captain Darrin's Atlantic pursuit of Giant Bluefin Tuna, then recreate a tuna fight using century-old fishing equipment Hemingway helped develop. They finish by trout fishing in Ketchum, Idaho, where Hemingway spent his final years.

history.us.title: Mountain Men - Wild North: The Long Way Home
history.us.description: A hard-earned haul is brought home; a treacherous journey takes an unexpected turn; a remote homestead gets an upgrade; an animal is honored from field to wall.

history.us.title: Mountain Men - Wild North: From The Ground Up
history.us.description: Spring hits and so does fire; a family is fed, a legacy is restored, and a livelihood hangs in the balance.

history.us.title: History's Mystery Files - Hidden Treasures
history.us.description: The search for treasure doesn't always lead to ancient ruins; sometimes, priceless history is concealed inside a home, buried among unwanted possessions, or waiting unnoticed at a garage sale.

history.us.title: History's Mystery Files - Puzzling Places
history.us.description: Across the globe, certain locations seem to resist explanation; from Japan's infamous "suicide forest" and enigmatic Knights Templar tunnels, to a top-secret wartime compound in Virginia; each holds clues to mysteries that have endured for generations.

history.us.title: History's Mystery Files - Secret Weapons
history.us.description: Desperate to gain the upper hand, military powers have pursued weapons that sound like science fiction: bat bombs, a hidden death ray and bizarre schemes designed to control the weather.

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Epic Fails
history.us.description: A miracle cure with a deadly catch; A romantic gesture explodes in a president's face; A simple home repair spirals wildly out of control; Sometimes the biggest disasters begin with the best intentions.

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Unlikely Heroes
history.us.description: How did a pet pig spring into action to save its owner's life? Which mysterious spirits became the unlikely heroes that turned the tide for a doomed flight? And what shocking move did a carjacker make to rescue a baby trapped in a scorching car? These are the wild, unexpected stories of heroes you'd never see coming.

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Man vs. Nature
history.us.description: Mother Nature doesn't always play nice, whether it's a mile-long sinkhole, a biblical swarm of crop-killing grasshoppers or an invasion of rum-fueled monkeys running wild on the island of St. Kitts; stories where humans go head-to-head with nature.

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Strange Places
history.us.description: Exploring the Lake Michigan Triangle and many other wild and weird places, including a doll-filled island with a dark past, deadly gas-filled explosive lakes, caves that harbor deadly viruses and a haunted place in the United States.

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Most Mischievous
history.us.description: History is full of mischief-makers, like the drunken pilot who steals a plane to win a bar bet; or the athlete who secretly mails himself across the world in a crate; how about the Houdini of orangutans who not only outsmarts every zookeeper, but inspires other apes to do it too; from pranksters to felons, these are history's most outrageous rule-breakers.

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Outlandish Inventions
history.us.description: Looking at outlandish inventions; a full-body gas mask for babies; Smell-o-Vision; a robot powered by eating slugs; inflatable airplanes; hidden cameras in contact lenses; coffin security systems.

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Unexpected Spectacles
history.us.description: Imagine a man floating through the sky by dozens of balloons or a circus only visible via magnifying glass; these are the tales of history's most unbelievable, strange and completely unexpected spectacles.

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - What Lies Beneath
history.us.description: A look at tales of strange things below Earth's surface, including sea beasts, hidden cities, and tunnels carved by giant sloths. (Documentary, History, Anthology) - 2024-02-02

history.us.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Bizarre Deaths
history.us.description: In Boston, a 25-foot tidal wave of molasses; a dancing plague that kills 100 people; a surgery with a 300% mortality rate; searching the globe for the strangest and most bizarre deaths on record. (Documentary, History, Anthology) - 2023-12-08

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Crime Seen
hln.us.description: Investigators reopen a case from 1984 involving the rape of a young Virginia woman when DNA testing refutes her identification of the rapist and calls everything into question, leading to the accused person's exoneration.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Speck of Evidence
hln.us.description: A speck of bicycle paint and a speck of nickel left over from a collision with a twice-convicted child molester's car provide critical clues in the murder of a 9-year-old.

hln.us.title: CNN This Morning
hln.us.description: Stories from across the world and conversations with Audie Cornish.

hln.us.title: CNN Table for Five ᴺᵉʷ
hln.us.description: Joining the table for a provocative discussion of the week's stories.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Tagging a Suspect
hln.us.description: Pieces of plastic the size of sand hold clues to a bombing.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Strong Impressions
hln.us.description: At first glance it appears a young woman suffocated, but further investigation shows the scene was staged.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Cereal Killer
hln.us.description: A killer is careless when a home is destroyed by fire and a young boy is missing.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Crash Course
hln.us.description: A patrol officer is shocked by the amount of blood at a traffic accident and is shocked by the coroner's ruling until an anonymous phone call re-ignites the case.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - A Leg up on Crime
hln.us.description: An irrigation canal murder remains unsolved until a similar murder occurs.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Tight-Fitting Genes
hln.us.description: The light of day and DNA picture painted by molecular biologist reveals new clues about a nighttime traffic accident.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Deadly Valentine
hln.us.description: On Valentine's Day, an obstetrician finds his wife dead and calls 911; police discover inconsistencies between the blood spatter evidence and his version of events.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Picture This
hln.us.description: Weed analysis and photogrammetry are used to help solve the 1995 murder of a California teenager is found dead after disappearing from her home.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Oily in the Morning
hln.us.description: When police recover the submerged car of a missing man, they find no body; the investigation that follows uncovers a deadly obsession and the motive for murder.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Gold Rush
hln.us.description: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. But the wound was not self-inflicted.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Four on the Floor
hln.us.description: Investigators piece together evidence found at the scene of a Native American woman's murder; the tire tracks and shoe impressions could lead them to the killer.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Writer's Block
hln.us.description: Experts seek answers to a young businesswoman's death just before she was to testify in a criminal trial.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - A Clean Getaway
hln.us.description: An anonymous caller reports the rape and murder of a dry cleaner employee; two eyewitnesses tell two similar but not identical stories. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2005-11-02

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Prints Among Thieves
hln.us.description: Police blame a botched robbery when an eccentric elderly millionaire is found dead, but the motive could be wrong. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2005-11-09

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Unholy Alliance
hln.us.description: Woman disappears from grocery store parking lot in Boulder, Colo.; investigators find extraordinary clues in a pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks, and ordinary grass and pine needles. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2005-11-16

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Signed, Sealed & Delivered
hln.us.description: A car carrying three men pulls up alongside another on an Alaskan highway and fires shots, leaving a passenger dead; one of the passengers in the killer's car agrees to testify against his friends; the resulting trials don't end the carnage. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2005-11-30

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Broken Bond
hln.us.description: A 2-year-old boy's brain seizures and breathing problems baffle doctors until they learn the mother exhibits signs of Munchausen syndrome by proxy, a rare condition that led her to physically abuse her son and contributed to her daughter's death. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1998-12-17

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Out of the Ashes
hln.us.description: Two years after an 18-year-old's murder in Albion, Mich., a tiny drop of blood and burned bones lead police to her killers. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1998-12-24

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Invisible Intruder
hln.us.description: A mother claims that an intruder murdered her two sons, but lacking a motive, police use blood-spatter analysis and behavioral profiling to reconstruct a different scenario. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-10-06

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - The Killing Room
hln.us.description: A routine missing persons report leads Texas police to discover a deadly love triangle; evidence found in a suspect's home matches the murder scene and leads to the indictment of the victim's girlfriend and her lover. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-10-13

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Ultimate Betrayal
hln.us.description: A 1995 fire razes the mansion of a Kansas doctor, killing two of her three children; disturbing accounts from an ex-husband lead investigators to believe the doctor set the blaze herself. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-10-20

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Cement the Case
hln.us.description: A husband confesses to his wife's murder, only to be found not guilty a year later when a phone tip and forensic evidence point to another. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-10-27

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Innocence Lost
hln.us.description: In Lorton, Va., police attempt to determine who abducted 5-year-old Melissa Brannen after she disappeared from a Christmas party, but cannot be certain until they match hair from a rabbit-fur jacket Brannen wore that day. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-11-03

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Til Death Do Us Part
hln.us.description: When a Pennsylvania man checks into a hospital for leg pain and later dies of thallium poisoning, police investigate his wife and find her in the process of collecting an insurance payment for her previous husband's death. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-11-10

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Body of Evidence
hln.us.description: Police exhume the body of Karla Brown, murdered in her home in 1978, to study bite wounds, which eventually lead to the killer. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-11-24

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Accident or Murder?
hln.us.description: A new life-insurance policy sparks suspicions of murder when a Nova Scotia schoolteacher's body is found at the bottom of her basement stairs. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-12-01

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Core Evidence
hln.us.description: A beverage company pleads guilty to violating federal safety laws when a baby dies from E. coli after drinking apple juice. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-12-08

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Haunting Vision
hln.us.description: A woman who survived a deadly childhood fire sends police a letter charging that her father killed her mother 30 years ago. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-12-15

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - With Every Breath
hln.us.description: After more than 20 people on a Native American reservation die suddenly from a flu-like disease, Navajo medicine men provide a clue that leads to a most unlikely killer. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-12-22

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Slippery Motives
hln.us.description: While at a real estate conference in St. Louis, a man finds his wife drowned in the bathtub in their hotel room. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 1999-12-29

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Badge of Deceit
hln.us.description: A cunning serial rapist who leaves no decisive evidence forces investigators to rely on geographical profiling in their search for an identity; DNA from a cigarette butt may provide the final piece of evidence needed to catch the suspect. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2000-09-12

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Dew Process
hln.us.description: New evidence including fibers and weather patterns point to a different killer in the 1986 case of a Pennsylvania dentist's murdered wife. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2000-09-19

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - A Woman Scorned
hln.us.description: Insects and a single strand of hair uncover an additional suspect in the killing of a young mother and her baby in Lehigh Valley, Pa. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2000-09-26

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - A Voice From Beyond
hln.us.description: A decomposed body is found in a barrel, and a dilapidated address book may hold the answer, but investigators must find a way to read the pages because the passage of 30 years has turned them blank. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2000-10-03

ifc.us.title: Meet the Fockers
ifc.us.description: Now that Greg Focker is "in" with his soon-to-be in-laws, Jack and Dina Byrnes, it looks like smooth sailing for him and his fiancée, Pam. But that's before Pam's parents meet Greg's parents, the Fockers. The hyper-relaxed Fockers and the tightly-wound Byrnes are woefully mismatched from the start, and no matter how hard Greg and Pam try, there is just no bringing their families together. This all adds up to a disastrously funny time of getting to know you.

When Brennan's mother and Dale's father marry and move in together, it turns the overgrown boys' world upside down. Their insane rivalry and narcissism pull the new family apart, forcing them to work together to reunite their parents.

indieplex.us.description: When her boyfriend is arrested for marijuana possession, Joleen Reedy (Charlize Theron) and her 11-year-old daughter, Tara (AnnaSophia Robb), take refuge with Joleen's aimless brother, James (Nick Stahl). Joleen soon runs off with a truck driver, and James is unable to meet his responsibilities. After Child Protective Services takes possession of Tara, James abducts her from a foster home, and the two travel from California to Utah, where his abusive father (Dennis Hopper) lives.

When her old Volkswagen breaks down, she receives a friendly invitation from Cathy to stay for a seemingly innocent business dinner. As the guests arrive and the wine starts to flow, Beatriz finds herself in an escalating war of words with Doug Strutt, a ruthless real estate mogul who cares more about money than people.

indieplex.us.description: Grace is a single mom who is often too busy juggling her job, bills and two love interests to pay much attention to her daughter, Ansiedad. Inspired by the coming-of-age stories her English teacher introduces in class, Ansiedad decides to skip adolescence and jump-start her life without her mother. But, when the misguided plan unravels, Ansiedad and Grace must both learn that growing up means acting your age.

indieplex.us.title: The Lucky Ones
indieplex.us.description: Stuck at a closed airport while on leave from Iraq War service, soldiers Colee Dunn (Rachel McAdams), Fred Cheaver (Tim Robbins) and T.K. Poole (Michael Peña) decide to carpool to get to their far-off destinations. Colee wants to visit with her late fiancé's family, while wounded T.K. longs to see his future wife and Fred, needing fast cash to send his son to college, is headed for a casino. During the journey, the soldiers forge a bond based on their uncertain futures.

kcal.us.title: Great Escapes
kcal.us.description: Grab the passport and settle in as "Great Escapes" takes viewers on incredible journeys. Each episode will take viewers on a trip to visit three destinations. These can be incredibly luxurious accommodations or the most rustic of rooms. Views can include a hotel made of ice that has ice cups, ice tables and even a bed of ice; an entire motel made of salt; one made of drainpipes; some others made from airplanes and shipping containers; a jail cell in Sweden; old bunkers to tree houses and luxury caves and even a zero gravity room in Slovenia. Continue to travel to destinations like French Polynesia, California, Sweden, Peru, Morocco, and other exotic and unique places.
