kcal.us.title: Zoo Clues
kcal.us.description: With all of the various animal species roaming around the planet there's a lot to know about animals, which means no one knows everything about them. Thankfully "Zoo Clues" fills in some of the blanks. Each half-hour episode investigates at least a dozen questions about animals to provide viewers with answers. Have you ever wondered if birds can fly backward, how animals without external ears hear, or why zebras have stripes? Those are among the questions waiting for answers on "Zoo Clues."

kcal.us.title: Animal Atlas

"Animal Atlas" teaches viewers about the animals' lives, histories and adaptations that allow them to survive in their environment. Whether it's visiting monkeys or heading underwater for a look at mammals that live in the ocean, "Animal Atlas" brings animals from around the globe into viewers' homes for an up-close look at how the animals live.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Her Last Patient
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Dr. Athena Hart thought she had seen every kind of broken soul-until Lucas Morningstar walked into her office. What begins as therapy quickly twists into a deadly game of obsession and revenge.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Heart of a Woman
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Alisha, a rising model with a bright future, chose to put her career on hold to stand by her football star husband Jax.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Buried
maverickblackcinema.us.description: After fleeing under a new identity following a suspected double murder, a man's quiet life in Florida unravels as neighbors probe his past.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Scarred
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Nate meets and hooks up with the beautiful Mia after a night out. Everything is beautiful, until Nate's wife Kamryn discovers his infidelity. The love triangle begins to spiral as everyone is on edge, and that some actions have deadly consequences.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Played in My Face
maverickblackcinema.us.description: A woman's life begins to unravel when she receives an email exposing her fiancé with another woman. Her quiet suspicion spirals into obsession as she discovers that her fiancé's betrayal runs deeper than she ever imagined.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Deadly Squatters
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Eugene and Laura return home from vacation to find that two young siblings have taken up residence in their home, and have now claimed legal rights as squatters. Forced to share their home with two strangers, they must play their wicked games and survive psychological terror as the legal system takes its time.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: He Killed My Sister
maverickblackcinema.us.description: When Malorie's sister, Monica, disappears, everyone around her tells her to grieve and move on. Determined to bring her justice, Malorie embarks on a search for the truth. But when she meets Tyriq, his motives may not be as pure as they seem.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: A Secret Lie in Love
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. But, their marriage that was built on passion, has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity and betrayal. Clarice finds solace in the arms of another man.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Shuttered Secrets
maverickblackcinema.us.description: When Trey's ex-girlfriend, Jada, unexpectedly shows up to his studio, she accuses him of dark secrets and being involved in a missing persons case. Their reunion quickly spirals into psychological warfare and violence. As the night goes on, the line between predator and victim blurs when other mysterious figures arrive and everything must be questioned.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Untangled Mirror
maverickblackcinema.us.description: J. Nicole is a determined mother, entrepreneur and hairstylist fighting to balance her personal and professional worlds while navigating love, family and the weight of false perceptions. By day, she runs her salon with pride, presenting herself.

mavtv.ca.title: En route vers l'ouest S07 E09
mavtv.ca.description: Véronique Labbé reçoit en musique et en entrevue Hert Leblanc et Rhéal Leblanc.

mavtv.ca.title: MUZ en spectacle…comme si vous y étiez S01 E04
mavtv.ca.description: Des soirées marquées par la diversité des univers musicaux de ces artistes professionnels québécois, d'ici ou d'ailleurs, qui ont fait le choix d'une créativité métissée d'influences de musiques du monde et aussi de jazz, de blues et autres.

mavtv.ca.title: Mères Alpha S01 E11
mavtv.ca.description: Karine Côté-Andreetti On dit souvent que ça prend un village pour élever un enfant. On parle d'amitié. Claudia échange avec Karine Côté-Andreetti, qui est autrice et experte en amitié et communauté.

mavtv.ca.title: Yoga avec Ève-Marie S01 E06
mavtv.ca.description: Calmer le système nerveux Un yoga restauratif combiné à la respiration pour apaiser le mental, diminuer le stress et relâcher les tensions internes.

mavtv.ca.title: Nos compagnons fauniques S01 E03
mavtv.ca.description: On parle de nos protecteurs canins avec la police de Gatineau.

mavtv.ca.title: La voix des animaux
mavtv.ca.description: Le café refuge et adoption chats sans abri On est prêt à tous pour les minous. Pas question de rester les bras croisés devant la surpopulation féline, les chats qui souffrent, qui errent, qui sont abandonnés.

mavtv.ca.title: Bonheur canin S02 E04
mavtv.ca.description: Les rapports entre les chiens Sophie Thibault vous invite à mieux comprendre l'adoption responsable, le bien-être canin et les ressources offertes dans les Basses-Laurentides.

mavtv.ca.title: Ça vient d'où? S01 E02
mavtv.ca.description: Les télécommunications On part à la découverte des moyens de communication à travers le temps, des messagers à cheval jusqu'au téléphone cellulaire.

mavtv.ca.title: L'adolescent bas-canadien S09 E03
mavtv.ca.description: École Jésus-Marie de Beauceville; Benjamin et Alie nous en apprennent plus sur les Têtes à claques, Joana et Fanny rencontrent l'humoriste Sam Vigneault et une chronique de Marc-Antoine et Alexandre à propos de François Pérusse.

mavtv.ca.title: La face cachée S05 E03
mavtv.ca.description: La face cachée des Archives nationales à Québec de BAnQ Les Archives nationales à Québec de BAnQ, ce sont 26 kilomètres de documents; découvrez les coulisses d'un lieu où se préserve la mémoire du Québec.

mavtv.ca.title: Cuisine Collective: une assiette santé, sociale et solidaire! S01 E05
mavtv.ca.description: On découvre comment concocter des repas sains, variés et de qualité avec un budget limité; chaque participant prépare trois recettes et repart avec des repas pour la semaine; on parle aussi d'inclusion sociale, d'autonomie et de sécurité alimentaire.

mavtv.ca.title: Forte de notre impact S01 E01
mavtv.ca.description: L'économie sociale en Mauricie: Trois-Rivières Pour cet épisode, nous rencontrons Pascal-Olivier Labrecque de Plein air Ville-Joie, Diane Vézina et Saül Bourgeois du Centre d'action bénévole du Rivage, ainsi qu'Anne-Marie Lavigne de l'atelier Silex.

mavtv.ca.title: Ça se passe au Salon S01 E04
mavtv.ca.description: Larry Tremblay Shannon Desbiens reçoit l'auteur Larry Tremblay pour échanger autour de son univers littéraire riche et percutant ; une rencontre captivante où l'écriture, les thèmes marquants et la singularité de son œuvre prennent vie au fil de la conversation.

mavtv.ca.title: Le coin des auteurs S01 E11
mavtv.ca.description: Chanelle Bouladier Laprade nous fait découvrir un auteur.

mavtv.ca.title: Tous les goûts sont dans la lecture S06 E07
mavtv.ca.description: Salon du livre de Granby En provenance du Salon du livre de Granby 2024, Carole Tardif rencontre plusieurs auteurs et autrices : Matilda Taupee Fortune, autrice, Collette Drapeau, autrice et Lily Gaudreault, autrice.

mavtv.ca.title: Nos artisans S02 E04
mavtv.ca.description: L'érablière Farsa et le moulin Légaré de Saint-Eustache Christophe vous emmène à Saint-Eustache, à la cabane à sucre Farsa où la tradition de l'érable se perpétue depuis 1955.

mavtv.ca.title: Fripez-vous? S01 E04
mavtv.ca.description: Cette semaine à Fripez-vous ?, Stéphanie Robillard-Sarganis visite les nouveaux locaux des Fripes du Relais à Boisbriand.

mavtv.ca.title: Le sport autrement S01 E06
mavtv.ca.description: Le sport-études Maude Pilon-Bernier part à la rencontre de jeunes athlètes passionnés qui concilient sport et études; elle entame son immersion au DARV Training; elle suit également les jeunes des Escadrons et les accompagne jusqu'en Floride.

mavtv.ca.title: Virage S02 E11
mavtv.ca.description: Changement de carrière, retour aux études, nouvelle passion, vie plus simple ; virage dresse le portrait intime de ceux qui ont osé le virage à 180 degrés ; écoutez leurs motivations, leurs défis et la réalité de leur nouvelle vie.

mavtv.ca.title: Fibre E S05 E11
mavtv.ca.description: Chaque semaine, on présente des entrepreneurs d'ici, les diverses facettes de leurs personnalités, leurs motivations, les défis et bien sûr la passion qu'ils ont pour l'entrepreneuriat.

mavtv.ca.title: Premières lignes S01 E13
mavtv.ca.description: La diversité sexuelle et de genre Éloïse Lagacé va à la rencontre des initiatives en matière de soutien pour la communauté 2SLGBTQIA+; elle rencontre l'équipe du Carrefour Jeunesse-Emploi Thérèse-De Blainville.

mavtv.ca.title: L'art de réussir S02 E11
mavtv.ca.description: Découvrez des histoires inspirantes, accessibles et motivantes qui démystifient l'entrepreneuriat et célèbrent la créativité, la persévérance et l'audace de celles et ceux qui bâtissent le monde de demain.

mavtv.ca.title: 609 avenue des citoyens S02 E01
mavtv.ca.description: Louis Gingras Dans cette première entrevue de la saison, Julie Paquin-Bergeron reçoit l'auteur-compositeur-interprète Louis Gingras.

mavtv.ca.title: Jeunes entrepreneurs S01 E11
mavtv.ca.description: Charles-David Baril Cette semaine, on rencontre Charles-David Baril de JAB Systems, une agence de marketing pour les entrepreneurs en construction.

metvplus.us.title: The Danny Thomas Show - The Perfect Crime

metvplus.us.title: Our Miss Brooks - Old Marblehead

metvplus.us.title: That Girl
metvplus.us.description: Aspiring actress Ann Marie moves to New York and works at a series of temp jobs while waiting for her big break in show business, while her overprotective father, Lou, looks on nervously. Although she is focused on her career, Ann also finds time to fall for magazine executive Donald Hollinger, to whom she eventually becomes engaged. Her friends include two married couples, the Bessemers and the Baumans. Harvey and George are her agents.

metvplus.us.title: Bosom Buddies - Macho Man

metvplus.us.title: ALF
metvplus.us.description: A smart-mouthed creature, ALF (aka Alien Life Form), crash-lands in a suburban garage. His spaceship is beyond repair, he's ugly, he's short, he's got a bad attitude. What's a family to do? Why, take in the furry creature, of course, and watch as he comments on humankind and tries to eat the cat -- a delicacy on his home planet of Melmac.

metvplus.us.title: S.W.A.T.
metvplus.us.description: The Olympic SWAT team, a newly formed special unit, strives to overcome challenges and solve dangerous criminal cases.

mgmplus.us.title: New Wave - Message in a Bottle
mgmplus.us.description: Inspired by punk's DIY energy and David Bowie, a new generation of outsider artists sparks a movement that becomes known as New Wave.

mgmplus.us.title: For a Few Dollars More
mgmplus.us.description: In the Wild West, a murderous outlaw known as El Indio and his gang are terrorizing and robbing the citizens of the region. With a bounty on El Indio's head, two bounty hunters, Monco and Col. Douglas Mortimer, come to collect the prize. Upon their first meeting, the two men view each other as rivals, but they eventually agree to become partners in their mutual pursuit of the vicious criminal.

mgmplus.us.title: Smurfs
mgmplus.us.description: When evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel take Papa Smurf, the Smurfs embark on a mission to the real world to save him. With help from some new friends, they must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe.

mgmplus.us.title: Legally Blonde
mgmplus.us.description: Elle Woods (Reese Witherspoon) has it all. She wants nothing more than to be Mrs. Warner Huntington III. But there is one thing stopping him (Matthew Davis) from proposing: She is too blond. Elle rallies all of her resources and gets into Harvard, determined to win him back.

mgmplus.us.title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
mgmplus.us.description: Elle Woods (Reese Witherspoon) journeys to Washington, D.C., to have her say about animal rights, but is ignored by every politician she encounters and quickly learns that the White House can be even tougher to navigate than the Ivy League. Finally, Elle makes the acquaintance of sympathetic Rep. Victoria Rudd (Sally Field), who helps the young lawyer get her foot in the door of Congress. Unfortunately, Elle still has to convince the entire legislature to hear her out.

mgmplus.us.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
mgmplus.us.description: Zack Mayo (Richard Gere), a new member of the U.S. Navy, has a bad attitude. When he signs up for the Aviation Academy, he is met with the strict leadership of Sgt. Emil Foley (Louis Gossett Jr.), who gives Zack a rude awakening in terms of relating with other people. Through Foley's guidance -- and an unexpected romance with Paula (Debra Winger), an outsider who hangs around the naval base -- Zack learns some tough lessons and discovers what he truly wants out of life.

mgmplus.us.title: Varsity Blues
mgmplus.us.description: In West Canaan, Texas, high school football reigns supreme. When starting quarterback Lance Harbor (Paul Walker) turns up injured, the Coyotes' ruthless coach, Bud Kilmer (Jon Voight), must promote benchwarmer Jonathon "Mox" Moxon (James Van Der Beek) to lead the team in its quest for a divisional title. Suddenly thrown into the spotlight, Mox must deal with the pressure of carrying the aspirations of an entire town on his shoulders, as he struggles to pursue his own very different dreams.

mgmplus.us.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
mgmplus.us.description: Bored billionaire Thomas Crown (Pierce Brosnan) decides to entertain himself by stealing a Monet from a reputed museum. When Catherine Banning (Rene Russo), an investigator for the museum's insurance company, takes an interest in Crown, a complicated back-and-forth game with romantic undertones begins between them. In an attempt to find out where Banning's loyalties lie, Crown returns the painting and essentially turns himself in, hoping that Banning's feelings for him will lead to an escape.

mgmplus.us.title: Worldbreaker
mgmplus.us.description: A father hides his daughter on an island to keep her safe while he equips her for survival and the battles ahead.

mgmplus.us.title: Project Hail Mary
mgmplus.us.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory slowly returns, he soon discovers he must solve the riddle behind a mysterious substance that's causing the sun to die out. As details of the mission unravel, he calls on his scientific training and sheer ingenuity but he may not have to do it alone. (movie) - 2026

mgmplus.us.title: Afterburn
mgmplus.us.description: After a massive solar flare destroys the Eastern Hemisphere, a treasure hunter for hire ventures to Europe to retrieve the coveted Mona Lisa, only to learn that the world needs a hero more than it needs a painting. (movie) - 2025

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Flesh & Blood
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: After being hired for an aborted coup, a group of unscrupulous warriors is abruptly disbanded. One of the mercenaries, Martin (Rutger Hauer), is determined to get revenge on his dismissive employer, Arnolfini (Fernando Hillbeck). To carry out his plan, Martin abducts the lovely Agnes (Jennifer Jason Leigh), the intended wife of Arnolfini's son, Steven (Tom Burlinson). Soon Martin and Steven are locked in an ongoing battle to see who will ultimately win the hand of Agnes.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Scared Stiff
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Accident-prone busboy Myron Mertz (Jerry Lewis) and his suave nightclub-crooner pal, Larry Todd (Dean Martin), get caught up in both a gangland slaying and a mystery involving the comely Mary Carroll (Lizabeth Scott). She has just inherited an island castle off the coast of Cuba that her lawyer, Cortega (George Dolenz), insists is overrun with ghosts and zombies. Attempting to save Mary from a mysterious stranger who wants her dead, Myron and Larry sail with her to Cuba.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Package
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Army Sgt. Johnny Gallagher (Gene Hackman) is reassigned after he angers Col. Glen Whitacre (John Heard) at a meeting of American and U.S.S.R. military types. Gallagher's new job is to shepherd detainee Thomas Boyette (Tommy Lee Jones) from Europe to the U.S. But when Gallagher loses track of his prisoner, he asks his ex-wife, a servicewoman with access to Boyette's background data, for help. As the chase leads Gallagher to Chicago, the intrigue ramps up in way he couldn't have imagined.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Marathon Man
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Mississippi Burning
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: When a group of civil rights workers goes missing in a small Mississippi town, FBI agents Alan Ward (Willem Dafoe) and Rupert Anderson (Gene Hackman) are sent in to investigate. Local authorities refuse to cooperate with them, and the African American community is afraid to, precipitating a clash between the two agents over strategy. As the situation becomes more volatile, the direct approach is abandoned in favor of more aggressive, hard-line tactics.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Hannibal
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Seven years have passed since Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) escaped from custody. The doctor is now at large in Europe. Mason Verger (Gary Oldman) remembers Lecter too, and is obsessed with revenge. Verger was Dr. Lecter's sixth victim, and though horribly disfigured, has survived. Verger realizes that to draw the doctor into the open, he must use someone as bait: Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore).

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Backdraft
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Chicago firefighting brothers Stephen (Kurt Russell) and Brian (William Baldwin) have been rivals since childhood. Brian, struggling to prove himself, transfers to the arson unit. There he aids Don (Robert De Niro) in his investigation into a spate of fires involving oxygen-induced infernos called backdrafts. But when a conspiracy implicating a crooked politician and an arsonist leads Brian back to Stephen, he is forced to overcome his brotherly competitiveness in order to crack the case.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Cop Land
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: When hotheaded Superboy (Michael Rapaport) accidentally gets involved in an ugly racially-motivated incident, his uncle Ray Donlan (Harvey Keitel), a corrupt New York City cop, attempts to sweep it under the rug by helping fake his nephew's death. The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Raging Bull
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: The violent nature of prizefighter Jake LaMotta leads first to a boxing championship, then to a downward spiral of self-destruction. (Movies, Drama) - 1980

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Ronin
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: An Irish ringleader (Natascha McElhone) organizes an international team of hired guns (Robert De Niro, Jean Reno) to retrieve a briefcase from criminals. (Movies, Action) - 1998

mgmplushits.us.title: Judgment at Nuremberg
mgmplushits.us.description: In 1947, four German judges who served on the bench during the Nazi regime face a military tribunal to answer charges of crimes against humanity. Chief Justice Haywood hears evidence and testimony not only from lead defendant Ernst Janning and his defense attorney Hans Rolfe, but also from the widow of a Nazi general, an idealistic U.S. Army captain and reluctant witness Irene Wallner.

mgmplushits.us.title: Downsizing
mgmplushits.us.description: Mild-mannered therapist Paul Safranek and his wife, Audrey, decide to undergo a process in which scientists shrink people down to miniature size to live in small communities. The irreversible procedure allows the people to gain wealth and a life of leisure while helping to cut down on the consumption of natural resources. As Paul gets to know his new neighbors and surroundings, he soon learns that living in a tiny suburb comes with its own set of huge problems.

mgmplushits.us.title: Valkyrie
mgmplushits.us.description: Col. Claus von Stauffenberg serves Germany with loyalty and pride but fears that Hitler will destroy his country if allowed to run unchecked. With time running out for Germany and the rest of Europe, von Stauffenberg joins a group of like-minded, high-ranking men who want to overthrow the Nazi regime from within. With everything he holds dear in the balance, von Stauffenberg becomes the trigger man in a plot to assassinate the evil dictator.

mgmplushits.us.title: Wildcat
mgmplushits.us.description: An ex-black ops team reunites to pull off a desperate heist and save an eight-year-old girl's life.

mgmplushits.us.title: Some Kind of Wonderful
mgmplushits.us.description: Keith Nelson (Eric Stoltz), an artsy high school outcast, tries to land a date with popular girl Amanda Jones (Lea Thompson) with some help from his tomboy best friend, Watts (Mary Stuart Masterson). However, his advances draw the ire of Amanda's snobby ex-boyfriend, Hardy Jenns (Craig Sheffer), who makes plans to get even. Matters are further complicated when Watts realizes she likes Keith as more than just a friend and tries to convince him to stop pursuing Amanda.

mgmplushits.us.title: Wonder
mgmplushits.us.description: Born with facial differences that, up until now, have prevented him from going to a mainstream school, Auggie Pullman becomes the most unlikely of heroes when he enters the local fifth grade. As his family, his new classmates, and the larger community all struggle to discover their compassion and acceptance, Auggie's extraordinary journey will unite them and prove you can't blend in when you were born to stand out.

mgmplushits.us.title: Rain Man
mgmplushits.us.description: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt (Tom Cruise) learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has an autistic older brother named Raymond (Dustin Hoffman) and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

mgmplushits.us.title: The Institute - Double Cross
mgmplushits.us.description: Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally.

mgmplushits.us.title: Secret Service
mgmplushits.us.description: MI6 agent Kate Henderson uncovers an audacious plot involving Russia and an asset in the UK Cabinet; Kate's hunt for the mole puts her agent's life at risk.

mgmplushits.us.title: Almost Famous
mgmplushits.us.description: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. (movie) - 2000

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Ladies' Man
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Upon losing his lover, Herbert (Jerry Lewis) gives up women for good and seeks a fresh start by taking a maintenance position at what appears to be an ordinary Los Angeles boarding house. To Herbert's surprise, however, the building caters specifically to single women. He immediately resolves to quit, but landlady Miss Wellenmellon (Helen Traubel) and sweet tenant Fay (Pat Stanley) talk him into keeping the job. In no time at all, Herbert is mired in one comic disaster after another.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Barefoot in the Park
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In this film based on a Neil Simon play, newlyweds Corie (Jane Fonda), a free spirit, and Paul Bratter (Robert Redford), an uptight lawyer, share a sixth-floor apartment in Greenwich Village. Soon after their marriage, Corie tries to find a companion for her mother, Ethel (Mildred Natwick), who is now alone, and sets up Ethel with neighbor Victor (Charles Boyer). Inappropriate behavior on a double date causes conflict, and the young couple considers divorce.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: When gigantic robots attack New York City, "Sky Captain" (Jude Law) uses his private air force to fight them off. His ex-girlfriend, reporter Polly Perkins (Gwyneth Paltrow), has been investigating the recent disappearance of prominent scientists. Suspecting a link between the global robot attacks and missing men, Sky Captain and Polly decide to work together. They fly to the Himalayas in pursuit of the mysterious Dr. Totenkopf (Laurence Olivier), the mastermind behind the robots.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: RoboCop
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In a violent, near-apocalyptic Detroit, evil corporation Omni Consumer Products wins a contract from the city government to privatize the police force. To test their crime-eradicating cyborgs, the company leads street cop Alex Murphy (Peter Weller) into an armed confrontation with crime lord Boddicker (Kurtwood Smith) so they can use his body to support their untested RoboCop prototype. But when RoboCop learns of the company's nefarious plans, he turns on his masters.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: RoboCop 2
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Cyborg Detroit policeman Alex Murphy is the sole officer on duty after the police force goes on strike against evil conglomerate Omni Consumer Products and its push to foreclose on the city of Detroit. Aside from dealing with the normal level of crime, Murphy must take on crime boss Cain, the spread of a dangerous new drug called Nuke and the attempt by psychologist Dr. Juliette Faxx to create another RoboCop using a hardened criminal.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: RoboCop 3
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Greedy corporation Omni Consumer Products is determined to begin development on its dream project, Delta City, which will replace the derelict Detroit. To achieve this end, O.C.P. is employing armed forces to bully residents out of the city, under the guise that they are just doing their part to reduce crime and root out thugs. After RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins the civilian resistance, he sustains severe injuries but recovers to battle advanced ninja robots developed by O.C.P.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Quigley Down Under
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) is an American rifleman who travels to the Australian outback to answer a help-wanted ad calling for a sharpshooter. When Quigley meets his employer, Elliott Marston (Alan Rickman), he's appalled to discover the job involves killing Aboriginal Australians. The two men fight, and when Quigley is knocked out, Marston leaves him and a local crazy woman (Laura San Giacomo) to die in a remote part of the Outback. They're rescued, however, and plot their revenge.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Magnificent Seven
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Looking to mine for gold, greedy industrialist Bartholomew Bogue seizes control of the Old West town of Rose Creek. With their lives in jeopardy, Emma Cullen and other desperate residents turn to bounty hunter Sam Chisolm for help. Chisolm recruits an eclectic group of gunslingers to take on Bogue and his ruthless henchmen. With a deadly showdown on the horizon, the seven mercenaries soon find themselves fighting for more than just money once the bullets start to fly.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Is God Is

moremax.us.description: Magical Nanny McPhee helps a harried mother who is trying to care for five children and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war.

moremax.us.title: Shazam!
moremax.us.description: Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana.

moremax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
moremax.us.description: When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives and the fate of the world.

moremax.us.title: Robin Hood
moremax.us.description: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of power.

moremax.us.title: Rampage
moremax.us.description: When three different animals become infected with a dangerous pathogen, a primatologist and a geneticist team up to stop them from destroying Chicago.

motortrend.us.title: Roadworthy Rescues - Great 8N
motortrend.us.description: In need of a new riding lawn mower, Derek heads east to find himself a 1950 Ford 8N tractor; with a cracked engine block and a bees' nest for a battery, Derek will have to revisit his farming routes to make this implement operational.

motortrend.us.title: Vegas Rat Rods - Iron Man and the Mullet
motortrend.us.description: Steve and the Welder Up crew have to get creative when they're tasked with building an iron-worker themed rat rod that doubles as a work truck; Justin makes a big mistake; Steve tries to flip a beat-up 1967 Coronet that he finds in a junkyard.

motortrend.us.title: Vegas Rat Rods - The Real Iron Man Revealed
motortrend.us.description: With only two weeks left to go, the Welder Up crew still has to build an engine for Tyrone's Iron Rod truck and install it and then re-cut the frame to add shocks.

motortrend.us.title: Hot Rod Garage - 10 Second Quarter-Mile for 10 Grand(ish) Bonemaro Hits Tens!
motortrend.us.description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa swap in a junkyard-fresh 5.3L on a low-buck drag project, the Bonemaro; they perform some critical upgrades along the way.

motortrend.us.title: My Classic Car - Sweden Car and Boat Show/Truckin' in the Music City
motortrend.us.description: Dennis travels to Sweden for a car and boat show, then he'll head over to Nashville to check out a couple of classic trucks.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - Road Tripping in the 700-hp Hemi Gremmie!
motortrend.us.description: The street freak 1975 AMC has had failures, but now the Hemi-powered Gremlin finally completes a road trip; Freiburger and Finnegan drive from Detroit to St. Louis and finally give the Hemi Gremmie the trip it deserves.

motortrend.us.title: Truck U - Finishing the Job D150
motortrend.us.description: Truck U puts the final touches on a Dodge D150 from Two Guys Garage. From protection under the bed, sound and heat insulation, better stance and firmer steering, this truck will finally be exactly what the owner always wanted.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - 87 Buick Grand National
motortrend.us.description: Restoring a Grand National takes a hard left turn; a 1987 Grand National owned the road in the 1980s, but has fallen on hard times.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - 68 El Camino
motortrend.us.description: A 1968 Chevrolet El Camino requires new brakes, a vital engine refresh and exhaust work to get it back on the road.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - 69 Charger
motortrend.us.description: Time and storage take a toll on a 1969 Dodge Charger that has remained in its original owner's family since it rolled off the lot.

motortrend.us.title: Two Guys Garage - Widebody C10
motortrend.us.description: Willie B and Kevin unveil an incredible wide-body C10 that could be their most ambitious project ever. The goal is to transform it into a 1,000-hp street machine, combining cutting-edge engineering, premium aftermarket parts and show-stopping style.

motortrend.us.title: Build for Off-Road - Body Swapped Chevy Part 2
motortrend.us.description: Ian returns to his body-swapped C10 build to show all the extra parts needed to get the twin turbo setup running; he tunes the engine and fires it up for the first time.

motortrend.us.title: Two Guys Garage - Race Nomad Wagon
motortrend.us.description: Willie and Kevin help the owner of a 1955 Nomad wagon complete this lifelong project and get it ready to go back on the track. (Automotive, Reality TV)

motortrend.us.title: Hot Rod Garage - Crown Hick Is Built AND Bought!
motortrend.us.description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa are reunited with the Crown Hick, a 1966 F-100 sitting on an entire 2007 Crown Victoria frame, with suspension upgrades and a supercharger. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Truck U - Big Diesel Power
motortrend.us.description: The Chevy 2500 AT4 is back in the shop for some maintenance and additional power after adding larger 37-inch tires. We will then go to a small town to see semi-trucks throw down to see who can tow 120,000 pounds uphill the quickest. (Automotive, Instructional)

motortrend.us.title: Hot Rod Garage - Turbocharged, Fuel Injected, Five-Speed...Minivan?!
motortrend.us.description: Tony and Lucky stray way off the beaten path with a 1990 Plymouth Voyager five-speed, turbocharged minivan; the boys refresh the suspension, engine and accessories until this 250,000-mile van is as good as new. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Turbocharged Eagle Rally Racer!
motortrend.us.description: Newbern and Cotten discover a gem which is not a typical American muscle with a turbocharged Eagle Talon; Shea Seefeldt challenges the guys on a rally course with his LS-swapped Subaru. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Monte Carlo Circle Track Surprise
motortrend.us.description: Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-body and an '80s-style, stock-car-inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Pro Street Mirada Makeover!
motortrend.us.description: Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada's engine dies on Roadkill; things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower and bigger tires, and bring the car back to its 1990s-era glory. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Tough Truck Mail Jeep!
motortrend.us.description: When Grave Digger himself calls you out, there's only one thing to do, send it; the guys send it by transforming a stock 1972 Jeep into a Tough Truck competitor to challenge the field at Dennis Anderson's Muddy Motorsports Park in North Carolina. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Top-Speed Trans Am!
motortrend.us.description: The guys attempt to build their '99 Trans Am into a 200-mph club member to compete at the Arkansas Mile; Keith Turk helps the guys find out how much horsepower they need to make, and they begin one of their most complex builds yet. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Pigpen vs. Crown Hick: Battle of the Body Swaps!
motortrend.us.description: The guys take on Hot Rod Garage's Lucky Costa and improve their shop truck Pigpen; it's their LS7-powered 1950 GMC 100 on an S15 chassis versus Lucky's 1966 Ford F-100 with a supercharged 4.6L on a police car chassis known as the Crown Hick. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Shocking Gains and Boosting the '60 Biscayne!
motortrend.us.description: The guys take a 1960 Chevrolet Biscayne and completely overhaul the suspension with an unconventional setup and supercharge the engine to make up time against a '66 Mustang GT350. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Hemi-Powered Monte Carlo!
motortrend.us.description: Newbern and Cotten take a G-Body to new heights when they swap a third-gen Hemi into a 1984 Monte Carlo. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - 200mph Trans AM!
motortrend.us.description: What does it take to get a Trans Am to 200 mph? The guys swing for the fences in an attempt at the elusive top speed of 200 mph. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Shocking Gains and Boosting the '60 Biscayne!
motortrend.us.description: The guys take a 1960 Chevrolet Biscayne and completely overhaul the suspension with an unconventional setup and supercharge the engine to make up time against a '66 Mustang GT350. (Automotive)

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - El Chili
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Gary Hopper, a longtime friend of Joe, brings a '55 Chevy Bel Air to the shop; because this '55 has sentimental value to Gary's family, the pressure is on to do this build right; but missing pieces and a dented hood throw a wrench into the job.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Instant Classic
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin is excited to see a straight '63 Impala with a four speed and legendary 409 engine under the hood; the owner wants to keep it original with the main mods under the body, new frame, suspension and big wheels.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Mint Condition
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A new customer, comes into the shop with an exceptional 1963 Cadillac; this car screams luxury but needs an upgrade; with Shane giving the MBC team creative freedom on the build, Joe gets to work on a plan; new engine, new wheels and a new interior.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Flaming '56
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Return customer Lee Farris comes to Martin Bros with a 1956 Chevy Bel Air, his first car that he wants to bring back to life; the first thing Joe notices is the outdated flame paint job.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Chop Top, Part 1
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin loves to push the limits; when a customer rolls into the shop with a 1950 Mercury Coupe, Joe Martin knows he needs to chop the top.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Chop Top, Part 2
motortrendfasttv.us.description: With the 1950 Mercury successfully chopped, the rest of the work can begin; the MBC team now has to marry the old roof with the new geometry of the newly chopped body; there are angles everywhere, and they are all out of whack.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Ramble On
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin gets some unusual cars coming through the door of his work shop, but when a customer from California arrives with a '63 Rambler wagon and tells Joe he can do what he wants with it, he decides to go to town with a radical custom job.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Brothers Nova, Part 1
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin loves Novas and his eyes light up when a new customer, Eric, wants him to customize a 1972 as a tribute to his brother, if they can find one; Shag and Amanda hunt down a '71, in what appears to be mint condition.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Brothers Nova, Part 2
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin and his crew are always under the gun, but their latest build, a '71 Nova, is well behind schedule, and they have a ton of work to do; Joe is really going to town on the metal work on this car, inside and out.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Chevrolet Camaro SS 1LE vs. 2018 Ford Mustang GT
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny Lieberman and Jethro Bovingdon try and figure out the answer to a 50-year-old question of Mustang or Camaro.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Chevrolet ZR2 vs. 2017 Ram Power Wagon: Who Needs a Ford Raptor?
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny Lieberman and Jethro Bovingdon head to the desert to test two of the toughest off-road trucks available.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Mercedes-AMG GT R vs. 2018 Porsche 911 GT3
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny Lieberman and Jethro Bovingdon take a look at two of the best sports cars to ever hail from Germany, the AMG GT R and the Porsche 911.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - Hot Rod Porsches! Gunther Werks 400R vs the SharkWerks GT3 4.1
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jethro Bovingdon and Jonny Lieberman take a look at two California-built custom Porsche 911s: the Gunther Werks 400R and the SharkWerks GT3 4.1.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2017 Ariel Atom 3.5R vs. 2017 Caterham 620R
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jethro Bovingdon is on home turf; he brings Jonny Lieberman to the UK and gives him a British sports car baptism.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Mercedes-AMG E63 S 4Matic+ Wagon vs. 2018 Porsche Panamera Turbo Sport Turismo
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny Lieberman and Jethro Bovingdon check out the current crop of fast station wagons available to savvy American consumers.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Aston Martin Vantage vs. 2018 Audi R8 RWS
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jethro Bovingdon and Jonny Lieberman head to Scotland to check out two cars that straddle the line between sports car and supercar, the Aston Martin Vantage and the Audi R8 RWS.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Dodge Challenger Hellcat Widebody vs. 2018 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny Lieberman and Jethro Bovingdon pit Chevy's and Dodge's modern-day muscle cars against each other on the burnout pad, a drift track, and the road.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Audi TT RS vs. 2018 Porsche 718 Cayman GTS
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jethro Bovingdon and Jonny Lieberman examine two performance cars that at first glance might not look like actual competitors, the Audi TT RS and the Porsche 718 Cayman GTS.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Jaguar XJR575 vs. 2018 Maserati Quattroporte GTS
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny Lieberman and Jethro Bovingdon take a classic trip from Los Angeles to Las Vegas in two full-size luxury cars, the 2018 Jaguar XJR575 and the 2018 Maserati Quattroporte GTS.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2018 Ferrari 812 Superfast vs. 2019 Dodge Challenger Hellcat Redeye
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny and Jethro visit the nearly 800 horsepower club. The Ferrari 812 Superfast and Dodge Challenger Hellcat Redeye might seem worlds apart on paper, but they are only separated by eight horsepower.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2019 McLaren 600LT vs. 2019 Porsche GT3 RS
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Comparing the McLaren 600LT, which features more power and less weight, against the Porsche GT3 RS to see if the 600LT can compete with the GT3 RS's performance.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - Shotgun Versus Scalpel! BMW's Mighty 2019 M2 Competition Takes on the Featherweight 2019 Alpine A110
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jethro and Jonny pit BMW's mighty mite M2 against the mid-engine, ultralight Alpine A110; it's a battle between a superstar athlete and a prima ballerina on rally stages, racetracks and one of the most exciting roads on Earth.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - REAL SUVs Battle Royale! Jeep Wrangler Rubicon vs. Mercedes-Benz G550
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny and Jethro head off the beaten path to look at two of the last hardcore production SUVs left on Earth like the Jeep Wrangler and the Mercedes G class.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2019 Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio vs 2019 Jaguar Project 8
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jethro and Jonny see if the mighty Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio has met its match; Jaguar's Project 8 has lots of tricked-out features, but with a price more than double the Alfa's, the battle is on for best sport sedan.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2019 MAT New Stratos vs. 2019 Superformance GT40 vs. 2019 Nissan GT-R Track
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny and Jethro look to the past and future of supercars; the MAT New Stratos repurposes Ferrari parts into something old made new, and the Superformance GT40 is a throwback to the '60s; but a modern GT-R might best them both.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - Who Knew $600,000 Could Be This Much Fun?
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny and Jethro live out their grand touring fantasies in two big British cars; each has high power and more leather than a cigar lounge; both turn out to be more fun on a road trip than imagined.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - 2019 Ford Mustang Shelby GT350 vs. 2020 Toyota GR Supra
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jethro and Jonny head south to pit Ford Mustang Shelby GT350 against the fifth-generation Toyota Supra.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - Drive It Like You Stole It! 2019 Civic Type R vs. 2020 Veloster N
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jethro and Jonny put the 2019 Honda Civic Type R and the 2020 Hyundai Veloster N through a rigorous battle around the racetrack, on canyon roads and in a test that involves unbridled hooliganism, police chases and lots of fire.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - Clash of the Odd Couple! '19 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 1LE vs. '20 Lotus Evora GT
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Comparing the 2019 Chevy Camaro ZL1 1LE and the 2020 Lotus Evora GT, two track-day specials, to determine which approach is better for solving the same track problem.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Head 2 Head - Holiday Hammer Down! 2019 BMW M5 Competition vs. 2019 Mercedes--AMG GT 63 S
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Jonny and Jethro wring out two super sedans, the BMW M5 Competition and the Mercedes--AMG GT 63 S; in upstate New York, they tear up some fabulous country roads, then head to the track at Lime Rock Park in Connecticut.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Let the Chef Cook
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Dave and the crew start on a 1966 Corvette, but his client doesn't want the color to be anywhere close to its original green.

movieplex.us.title: Paws P.I.
movieplex.us.description: A boy recruits his talking dog and parrot to help him take down a tyrannical tycoon who's determined to stop a local mansion from being turned into an animal rescue.

movieplex.us.title: Pups United
movieplex.us.description: A group of talking dogs team up to save the Youth World Cup soccer finals.

movieplex.us.title: The Shortcut
movieplex.us.description: Children grow up avoiding a path after kids go missing near a creepy old man's house. Now high school seniors, they decide to find out what the shovel-wielding weirdo is hiding.

movieplex.us.title: Chappaquiddick
movieplex.us.description: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious events forever alters his political legacy and changes the course of presidential history.

movieplex.us.title: All Is Lost
movieplex.us.description: During a solo voyage in the Indian Ocean, a veteran mariner (Robert Redford) awakes to find his vessel taking on water after a collision with a stray shipping container. With his radio and navigation equipment disabled, he sails unknowingly into a violent storm and barely escapes with his life. With any luck, the ocean currents may carry him into a shipping lane -- but, with supplies dwindling and the sharks circling, the sailor is forced to face his own mortality.

movieplex.us.title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
movieplex.us.description: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that according to legend will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. When Angel is kidnapped by a mad treasure hunter, Mindy and her school friends head into the hills to rescue the pony and hunt for the lost gold.

movieplex.us.title: The Winning Season
movieplex.us.description: Increasingly estranged from his own daughter, a boozy busboy (Sam Rockwell) gets a shot at redemption when an old friend (Rob Corddry) hires him to coach a varsity girls basketball team.

movieplex.us.title: Lulu on the Bridge
movieplex.us.description: A seemingly magic stone leads an aging, injured musician (Harvey Keitel) into love with a young, aspiring actress (Mira Sorvino).

movieplex.us.title: Love Me
movieplex.us.description: A teen (Lindsey Shaw) begins a romance with a new student (Jamie Johnston) who becomes a suspect in the disappearance of a girl (Kristina Elliott).

movieplex.us.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
movieplex.us.description: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

movieplex.us.title: The Honor List
movieplex.us.description: Four girls sink a time capsule in a lake with a list of things they want to do before graduation, but they all go separate ways before graduating. When a tragedy strikes, they reunite to find the capsule and complete the bucket list. (movie) - 2018

movieplex.us.title: Fisherman's Friends: One and All
movieplex.us.description: Following the unexpected success of their debut album, members of the musical group Fisherman's Friends struggle with the pressures, pitfalls and temptations of their newfound fame. (movie) - 2022

movies.us.title: Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins
movies.us.description: An ancient Japanese clan called the Arashikage welcomes tenacious loner Snake Eyes after he saves the life of their heir apparent. Upon arrival in Japan, the Arashikage teach him the ways of the ninja warrior while also providing him something he's been longing for: a home. However, when secrets from Snake Eyes' past are revealed, his honor and allegiance get tested -- even if that means losing the trust of those closest to him.

movies.us.title: Jackass: The Movie
movies.us.description: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

movies.us.title: Jackass: Number Two
movies.us.description: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy.

movies.us.title: Jackass 3
movies.us.description: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull."

movies.us.title: Jackass Forever
movies.us.description: Celebrate the joy of a perfectly executed shot to the groin as Johnny Knoxville, Steve-O and the rest of the gang return for another round of hilarious, wildly absurd and often dangerous displays of stunts and comedy.

movies.us.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
movies.us.description: Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series.

movies.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
movies.us.description: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman.

movies.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do the Universe
movies.us.description: Blasting off on a NASA space mission in 1998, mischievous best pals Beavis and Butt-head time travel to the year 2022. As the NSA and U.S. government try to track them down, the clueless teens do their best to adjust to modern life.

movies.us.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
movies.us.description: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them.

movies.us.title: Bad Santa
movies.us.description: In this dark comedy, the crotchety Willie (Billy Bob Thornton) and his partner (Tony Cox) reunite once a year for a holiday con. Posing as a mall Santa and his elf, they rip off shopping outlets on Christmas Eve. This year, however, Willie is falling apart. He's depressed and alcoholic, and his erratic behavior draws the suspicion of mall security (Bernie Mac). But when befriending a small boy brings out his kinder side, Willie begins to wonder if there is still some hope for him.

movies.us.title: Bad Santa 2
movies.us.description: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Soke (Billy Bob Thornton) teams up with his angry little sidekick, Marcus, to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity. Mommy issues arise when the pair are joined by Willie's horror story of a mother, Sunny Soke, who raises the bar for the gang's ambitions, while somehow lowering the standards of criminal behavior. (movie) - 2016

movies.us.title: Scrooged
movies.us.description: In this modern take on Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol," Frank Cross (Bill Murray) is a wildly successful television executive whose cold ambition and curmudgeonly nature has driven away the love of his life, Claire Phillips (Karen Allen). But after firing a staff member, Eliot Loudermilk (Bobcat Goldthwait), on Christmas Eve, Frank is visited by a series of ghosts who give him a chance to re-evaluate his actions and right the wrongs of his past. (movie) - 1988

movies.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
movies.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination. (movie) - 1987

moviesphere.us.title: Trauma Center
moviesphere.us.description: Alone and trapped in a locked-down hospital isolation ward overnight, an injured young woman must escape a pair of vicious killers who are after the only piece of evidence that can implicate them in a grisly murder: the bullet in her leg.

moviesphere.us.title: Akeelah and the Bee
moviesphere.us.description: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

moviesphere.us.title: The Great Debaters
moviesphere.us.description: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions.

moviesphere.us.title: Pride
moviesphere.us.description: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

moviesphere.us.title: Fruitvale Station
moviesphere.us.description: Though he once spent time in San Quentin, 22-year-old black man Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan) is now trying hard to live a clean life and support his girlfriend (Melonie Diaz) and young daughter (Ariana Neal). Flashbacks reveal the last day in Oscar's life, in which he accompanied his family and friends to San Francisco to watch fireworks on New Year's Eve, and, on the way back home, became swept up in an altercation with police that ended in tragedy. Based on a true story.

moviesphere.us.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
moviesphere.us.description: For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Merry Christmas, Mr Plankton Part 1
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Minions: The Rise of Gru

When the interview turns disastrous, Gru and his Minions go on the run with the Vicious 6 hot on their tails. Luckily, he finds an unlikely source for guidance -- Wild Knuckles himself -- and soon discovers that even bad guys need a little help from their friends.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie

When their mean principal threatens to separate them into different classes, the mischievous boys accidentally hypnotize him into thinking that he's a ridiculously enthusiastic, incredibly dimwitted superhero named Captain Underpants.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Shrek
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Once upon a time, in a far away swamp, there lived an ogre named Shrek whose precious solitude is suddenly shattered by an invasion of annoying fairy tale characters. They were all banished from their kingdom by the evil Lord Farquaad. Determined to save their home, not to mention his, Shrek cuts a deal with Farquaad and sets out to rescue Princess Fiona to be Farquaad's bride. Rescuing the Princess may be small compared to her deep, dark secret.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Shrek 2
nickelodeonwest.us.description: After returning from their honeymoon and showing home movies to their friends, Shrek and Fiona learn that her parents have heard that she has married her true love and wish to invite him to their kingdom, called Far Far Away. The catch is: Fiona's parents are unaware of the curse that struck their daughter and have assumed she married Prince Charming, not a 700-pound ogre with horrible hygiene and a talking donkey pal.

outlaw.us.title: Montana Belle
outlaw.us.description: Belle Starr (Jane Russell), a voluptuous outlaw, is lying low in a small desert town with Bob Dalton (Scott Brady) and his feckless bank robber brothers. When wealthy saloon keeper Tom Bradfield (George Brent) takes a liking to her, Belle reassesses her options and considers playing the men against each other. Knowing that Tom wants to get Bob out of the picture, she leads one suitor on a crime spree against the other while puzzling through her complicated romances.

outlaw.us.description: A cavalry deserter (Sterling Hayden) poses as a major and leads a wagon train with a hidden cargo of repeating rifles.

outlaw.us.title: They Died With Their Boots On
outlaw.us.description: George Armstrong Custer (Errol Flynn) is a rebellious but ambitious soldier, eager to join the Civil War. During the war, Custer has numerous successes to his credit, even though he disobeys orders. After the war concludes, he marries Libby Bacon (Olivia de Havilland) and is assigned to the Dakota Territory. Custer negotiates honestly with the Sioux on land, but due to corruption from others, a battle with Sitting Bull's forces occurs at Little Big Horn.

outlaw.us.title: San Antonio
outlaw.us.description: Rancher Clay Hardin (Errol Flynn) has discovered that local saloon owner Roy Stuart (Paul Kelly) is selling cattle that doesn't belong to him, including some of Clay's own stolen stock. Armed with a tally book that proves it, Hardin now finds himself the target of Stuart's posse of gunslingers, who will stop at nothing to prevent Hardin from delivering the evidence to the proper authorities. With no one to help him except a few of his friends, Hardin has to fight for his cattle, and his life.

pop.us.description: Sally and Gillian Owens, born into a magical family, have mostly avoided witchcraft themselves. But when Gillian's vicious boyfriend, Jimmy Angelov, dies unexpectedly, the Owens sisters give themselves a crash course in hard magic. With policeman Gary Hallet growing suspicious, the girls struggle to resurrect Angelov -- and unwittingly inject his corpse with an evil spirit that threatens to end their family line.

pop.us.title: You've Got Mail
pop.us.description: Struggling boutique bookseller Kathleen Kelly hates Joe Fox, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. Eventually Joe learns that the enchanting woman he's involved with is actually his business rival. He must now struggle to reconcile his real-life dislike for her with the cyber love he's come to feel.

pop.us.title: Selena
pop.us.description: In this biographical drama, Selena Quintanilla (Jennifer Lopez) is born into a musical Mexican-American family in Texas. Her father, Abraham (Edward James Olmos), realizes that his young daughter is talented and begins performing with her at small venues. She finds success and falls for her guitarist, Chris Perez (Jon Seda), who draws the ire of her father. Seeking mainstream stardom, Selena begins recording an English-language album which, tragically, she would never complete.

It's up to Fuzzy and Billy to stop the thieves before they make off with the stolen mail -- and with the money and secrets that it contains.

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass

Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

retroplex.us.title: In Old Caliente
retroplex.us.description: In California, Roy (Roy Rogers) works on the large ranch of Don Jose (Frank Puglia), one of the last of the major Spanish landowners. The foreman of the ranch, Saguaro (Jack LaRue), is involved with a gang of bandits and hopes to pit the newly arriving Americans against the dwindling Spanish and native populations. Saguaro becomes Roy's nemesis, getting him banished from the ranch and framing him for various crimes, but Roy concocts an audacious plan to clear his name.

retroplex.us.title: Man From Oklahoma

retroplex.us.title: Outride the Devil: A Morning With Doc Holliday

retroplex.us.title: Rimfire

retroplex.us.title: The Red Stallion
retroplex.us.description: Elderly Aggie Curtis is in financial trouble and must come up with cash or sell the horse ranch she runs with her orphaned grandson, Joel. Hoping to save the ranch, Joel decides to train his favorite horse, a stallion named Red, to race. This proves to be no easy task, though -- while Red is speedy, he's also quite unruly. But the Curtises' wealthy neighbor, Moresby, takes an interest in buying Red, and Joel must consider selling his animal pal.

retroplex.us.title: Man About Town
retroplex.us.description: Hollywood agent Jack Giamoro (Ben Affleck) has a ruthless dedication to his work and a tendency to neglect his wife, Nina (Rebecca Romijn). Upon discovering that Nina has been sleeping with an up-and-coming actor, Giamoro enrolls in a self-help course and begins keeping a diary. But, when that diary, with its tell-all account of Giamoro's professional and personal turmoil, falls into the hands of freelance writer Barbi Ling (Bai Ling), he struggles to retrieve it and prevent a massive scandal.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Engineering Europe - Spain
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Spain's engineering wonders revealed: from Barcelona's groundbreaking cathedral to the world's largest stadium, and a skyscraper that appears to float.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Stacey Dooley's Australia - Island On The Edge
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Stacey Dooley visits Kangaroo Island, where residents are rebuilding after devastating bushfires. Along the way, she explores the island's wildlife, scenery and strong community spirit.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Beyond The Logo: The Story Behind Brands - Ikea
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: The Flat-Pack Phenomenon explores how a Swedish start-up became a global furniture giant, revolutionising home design while facing growing sustainability challenges.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Adam Hills: The Last Leg

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: The Vampire Lestat - Don't Be Afraid, Just Start The Tape
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: With Louis's help, Molloy delves into a haunted memory of his own.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Tokyo Vice - The War At Home
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: A death at Chihara-kai causes upheaval. Jake makes a long overdue visit home. Katagiri hopes a perp will help break his case wide open.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Tokyo Vice - The Noble Path
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Jake's successful trip to the U.S. propels the group in a new direction, while Katagiri struggles with his case's devastating turn of events.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: France 24 Africa News - Sunday 29 November 2026
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Join France24's Georja Calvin-Smith for a round up of the week's cultural and current affairs stories from across the African continent. Delivered via satellite from Paris, in English, no subtitles.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: DW English News - Morning
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: News and analysis of the top international and European news and current affairs from Berlin, in English.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: FBC News Fiji - Sunday 29 November 2026
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Local, world, sport and entertainment news in English from FBC News, Suva Fiji.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: France 24 Feature - First Edition

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Euronews - Sunday 29 November 2026
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Headlines, Breaking News & Analysis from the Euronews news centre in Brussels, Belgium, in English.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Global Us - Sunday 29 November 2026
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Deutsche Welle's news magazine looks at the issues that are moving us today and shows how people are living with the opportunities and risks of globalisation.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: CBC The National
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: THE NATIONAL is CBC's flagship nightly news program, featuring the day's top stories with in-depth and original journalism.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: Horizons from PBS News - Sunday 29 November 2026
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: Dive into the world of science, health, technology and environmental issues making headlines each week, hosted by PBS News Hour's William Brangham.
